source_issue.title: Add deprecation policy or guide to documentation

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need for a clear deprecation policy and guidelines in the Volto documentation. Currently, there are no dedicated resources for developers on how to deprecate features effectively, despite having similar guidance available for Plone 6.

## What needs to be done
We need to create a section specifically about deprecation in Volto. This could take the form of a dedicated "Deprecation policy" page or add guidelines to the existing Version policy. It should include practical examples and Volto-specific details that adapt current Plone 6 documentation.

## Helpful background
The discussion indicates that adapting existing guidance from Plone 6 could be beneficial. There is agreement among contributors on the importance of these guidelines, but no consensus on the structure or format as of now. This requires further discussion among the team to finalize an approach.

## Good first steps
1. Review the existing Plone 6 deprecation guides to understand the content.
2. Participate in upcoming team discussions to share your ideas on how to structure the new documentation.
3. Once a path is agreed upon, you can help draft or refine the new documentation section.
4. If you're unsure, feel free to reach out to team members for guidance and support.
```
